---------------------------------------------

Acquired in 2022, Elevate Jet is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Elevate Aviation Group. It has been a premier provider of aircraft charter, management, and sales and brokerage services for almost 30 years.  
  
Based in Salt Lake City, UT, the aviation company maintains a diverse fleet of private jet aircraft for charter to fit any trip or budget and provides tailored travel solutions to meet business and personal travel needs. Elevate Jet offers the added benefit of in-house maintenance capabilities through its affiliated FAA-certified Part 145 MRO facilities, ensuring seamless support and maximum aircraft availability. The company is also regularly audited by third-party industry examiners, including Argus and Wyvern.
